facts.text: Serve the snacks when Aunt Cass brings out her hot wings.
facts.why: Cass says she will whip up chicken wings with the hot sauce that makes their faces numb.

facts.text: Showtime: Serve the snacks when Aunt Cass brings out her hot wings.
facts.why: Same cue as printed. Cass makes chicken wings with hot sauce that numbs their faces.

facts.text: Hiro, sweetheart, you can't save the city on an empty stomach. Eat.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Not a line Cass says. The two quote pages I opened (Hiro, Fred and Honey Lemon lines only) have no Cass dialogue, so no source could prove it, but it matches nothing I know from the film. She does cook for Hiro, so a written note fits.
facts.fix: Hiro, sweetheart, saving the city is no reason to skip dinner. Eat.
